evidence.quote: We used geometric mean of pairwise ratios as the normalization method for zero-inflated sequencing data, a method developed recently to correct for bias introduced by variable sequencing depth [ 25 ]. We further ran the decontam algorithm using the frequency-method as implemented in R to assess contamination and decontaminate the sequencing data prior to further analysis [ 26 ]. See Table S3 for the removed taxa which were identified as contamination following the decontam algorithm.
